_comment: JARVIS 2 example config. Copy to ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and adapt. Secrets go in ~/.openclaw/.env, NOT here. See jarvis/README.md for the full walkthrough.

list._workspace_comment: Point the workspace at your JARVIS folder so JARVIS.md + HEARTBEAT.md load as durable context. Use an absolute path on your machine.
list._skills_comment: Allowlist keeps JARVIS focused. Add/remove skills you actually use. 'jarvis' is the orchestration brain (loaded via skills.load.extraDirs below).

heartbeat.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists (workspace context). Follow it strictly. If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.

load._comment: Load the bundled JARVIS orchestration skill from this repo. Use an absolute path on your machine.

memory._comment: Start with the built-in memory plugin. To use Supabase as long-term memory/CRM, see jarvis/supabase/schema.sql and wire it via the Supabase MCP server + the jarvis skill's memory routing.

cron._comment: Enables scheduled jobs. Create the morning brief / EOD wrap with `openclaw cron` (see jarvis/README.md → Proactive briefings). Heartbeat above drives the checks; cron triggers them on a schedule.

telegram._comment: Front door. Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in ~/.openclaw/.env (from @BotFather). Lock dmPolicy to just you.

messages._comment: Outbound voice (JARVIS talks back). Pick ONE provider and put its key in ~/.openclaw/.env. 'edge' needs no API key and is the easiest start; 'elevenlabs' gives the best JARVIS-like voice. Inbound voice notes (you talk to JARVIS) are transcribed by the 'openai-whisper' or 'openai-whisper-api' skill — add it to the agent skills allowlist and see docs.openclaw.ai.
